**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Place the new span-ending helpers after their callers**

In both modified `WrappedFutureCallback` classes, the new private `endSpan` method precedes `completed`, `failed`, and `cancelled`, which call it. The **Class organization** rule in `.github/instructions/java-style.instructions.md` explicitly requires “Place callers before callees.” Move `endSpan` below its callback callers in both modules to comply with the documented repository convention.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L20-L24](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/8a2fbc56d35354861d3d13c6f54f9a0b9368daab/AGENTS.md#L20-L24)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

Response lookup now runs even when `context` is null, so a throwing getter or incompatible response attribute in a caller-supplied `HttpContext` can prevent callback delivery for suppressed requests or early termination. Move `getResponseFromHttpContext()` inside `endSpan`'s non-null-context branch and have all three terminal callbacks pass only the exception. The same change is needed in `instrumentation/apache-httpclient/apache-httpclient-5.0/javaagent/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/instrumentation/apachehttpclient/v5_0/ApacheHttpAsyncClientInstrumentation.java:189`.
